messages:
nia: design quick-hit: small UX/a11y cleanups in Settings > Compliance. Observed: (1) region selector focus jumps when you tab from Retention, (2) the key pill reads 'Managed key - Redwood' and users keep asking if we can decrypt, and (3) audit log times look inconsistent when users change timezone. Can we tidy in one small PR?

matt: Repro for #1: tab into Retention, open it, then Tab to Region. Region dropdown briefly opens then collapses. Verified on Chrome + Safari.

zara: Sounds like the common blur race: trigger loses focus before the list receives it. Fix: keep aria-expanded=true until list gets focus, put options immediately after trigger in DOM, and only close on Escape or click-out. Also set role="listbox" and manage aria-activedescendant.

matt: I'll prototype that. Also plan to programmatically focus first option when the user Tabs into the region trigger and the list is already open.

lex: On key copy: Ops is getting tickets: users read "Managed key - Redwood" and think Redwood can decrypt customer data. We should pick language that avoids legal/ops assumptions. Options I mocked: 
- "Key custody: Redwood"
- "Key custody: Customer (BYOK)"
- Short fallback: "Owner: Redwood / Customer (BYOK)"
I prefer "Key custody" over "Managed" to reduce misreads.

zara: If we change label words we must update support scripts. Support asked for a canonical one-line we can paste into canned replies. Proposed: "Key custody — Redwood-managed / Customer-managed (BYOK)" with a hidden aria-describedby that reads: "Indicates who can rotate or revoke the master key."

nia: Good. Also add a help icon that opens a tiny modal (accessible) with two bullets: what each option means and a link to docs. Modal copy should explicitly say we do not hold key material for BYOK. Keep modal <140 words.

lex: For visuals, current pill hover contrast measured ~3.2:1 for 12px text against bg. Need >=4.5:1. Options: raise font-weight to 600, darken background, or use 13px body. I prefer weight + slight bg darken to keep spacing. Also ensure focus ring is 3px solid and meets contrast.

matt: Noted. I'll include before/after color swatches in the PR and the contrast numbers.

qa-bot: Accessibility flag: add aria-describedby to the pill pointing to a visually-hidden explanation. Verify with VoiceOver that the pill reads the description when focused. Also include a keyboard test case: Tab sequence from Retention -> Region (open) -> first option gets focus.

lex: Telemetry request from support: add data-key-custody="redwood|customer" on the settings row so triage can quickly see which projects are BYOK. Make sure infra strips any KMS identifiers and we do not log key ids. Retention for that flag? Ops prefers 90 days.

nia: Agree on telemetry but confirm retention with infra. Also we need to be careful not to expose that attr in community screenshots or logs.

zara: Audit log CSV behavior: current CSV uses UTC while console shows local. Security asked for unambiguous exports. Two options: (A) always export ISO+offset (recommended), (B) export in user's timezone. I vote for ISO+offset, e.g., 2026-02-14T09:12:00-08:00. In the UI show header 'Timestamp (local)' + tooltip 'Export uses ISO-8601 with offset.'

matt: I'll change export to ISO+offset and update header to 'Timestamp (your timezone)'. Also add a small toggle in the export dialog: [Export as UTC].

lex: Mobile nit: on narrow widths the help icon disappears behind the pill. On <420px we should hide the icon and show a one-line 'Learn more' link under the row. Ensure the modal is reachable via keyboard and the link has aria-controls to open modal.

nia: Plan: matt will PR DOM reorder + role/listbox + focus fix + export ISO change + updated pill styles. lex will draft microcopy for pill + modal and update support canned reply. zara will add VoiceOver notes to component README. qa-bot will add test cases. Can we aim for PR by Wednesday EOD?

matt: Yep. I'll attach screenshots, contrast measurements, and a voiceover test log.

lex: I'll push the support blurb: "Key custody — Redwood-managed / Customer-managed (BYOK). Redwood-managed keys may be rotated by Redwood; BYOK means you provide and control key material.
Support canned reply: 'If your project is BYOK, Redwood does not have access to your key material and cannot decrypt data without your key.'"

nia: Perfect. Thanks everyone :sparkles:
